title: 1985 Fleer #632 Charlie Lea Montreal Expos Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 1985 Fleer sports trading card features the Montreal Expos' all-star game with players Gary Carter and Charlie Lea. The card is part of the base set and has the card number 632. It is a great addition for any baseball fan's collection, especially those who are fans of the Major League Baseball (MLB). The card is not autographed and is manufactured by Fleer. The season the card represents is 1985.
